artworks.title: On avait... joliment graissé le mât
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting a pole with a climber reaching for the word "Liberté" under "Suffrage Universel," surrounded by a crowd. The drawing presents a central tall pole around which a figure is climbing and reaching towards the word "Liberté" at the top. The climber appears to be in an effortful pose, emphasizing the theme of striving for freedom or universal suffrage. The wording "Suffrage Universel" encircles the pole near the top. A crowd surrounds the base, with several individuals depicted with their heads turned upwards, some with raised arms and hats as if cheering or encouraging the climber. The lower portion includes a caption in French, adding context to the image. The style of the drawing is in a satirical or political cartoon tradition with an emphasis on gestural lines and stark contrasts.

artworks.title: Premier prix de croissance - La Prusse
artworks.description: The image displays two figures. One is fully visible and the other partially shown. The figure on the left is in a bowing position with a side profile visible, dressed in a long garment with "PRUSSE" written on it. This figure has a prominent nose, a pointed helmet, and a slightly hunched appearance. The figure on the right is fully visible, seated on steps, wearing a long dress with "1867" written on it. This seated figure has an updo hairstyle, classic facial features, and is extending its right arm to place a laurel wreath on the head of the bowing figure. Both figures are in a formal setting, with indistinct figures in the background.

artworks.title: Prudhomme obligé de prendre des leçons...
artworks.description: The image shows a scene with a horse and a carriage. An individual is almost falling from the horse, indicated by a falling hat. Another character, wearing a hat and holding a whip, is riding alongside in a determined posture. The expressions and body language suggest surprise or alarm. The background is minimal, emphasizing the central figures and the lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Réflection intime d'un épicier
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a man observing a crowd. The scene shows a solitary figure standing amidst a bustling crowd. The crowd is depicted with swift, energetic strokes, creating a sense of movement and activity. The lone figure stands out due to his posture and attire, and appears contemplative with his hands clasped behind his back. The setting seems to be outdoors, suggested by loose foliage overhead. There is a stark use of light and shadow, creating a contrast between the figure, the crowd, and the background. The written French text underneath adds a layer of social commentary.

artworks.title: Renouvelé des Japonais
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a spinning top labeled 'EQUILIBRE EUROPEEN' above a hand holding a sword. The artwork presents a visual metaphor with a hand gripping a sword that seems to slice through or interact with the spinning top. The top is detailed with lines indicating its motion, while the sword is confidently held. The composition is monochromatic, using shades of grey. The title is 'Renouvelé des Japonais,' suggesting it is a satirical comment likely from the era of political cartoons.

artworks.title: Si je n'allais pas être réélu!
artworks.description: The image shows a solitary figure sitting at a desk in a structured hall. The individual appears focused and deep in thought, surrounded by empty seats that fade into the background. The drawing uses strong lines and shading to emphasize the figure's expression and posture, creating a dramatic scene of introspection.

artworks.title: Un Banquet d'hippophages
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two chefs holding plates with unique dishes. The image features two figures in chef attire, one holding a plate containing horseshoes, and the other presenting a horse's head on a dish. They are in a culinary setting with pans and cooking utensils on the wall behind them. The scene conveys humor and satire through the exaggerated expressions on the chefs' faces and the unconventional meal presentation. The drawing is a caricature with expressive line work and shading, creating depth and texture.

artworks.title: Un procédé pour qu'il marche sans avancer
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse walking in a circle while harnessed to a large cylindrical stone. The horse appears to be laboriously moving around an immobile, massive object. On its head, there is a cap with the word "PROGRES" on it. The horse looks weary and burdened, as it is tethered to this stone mechanism. The monochrome medium and style of the drawing indicate a satirical or editorial comic artwork. The caption at the bottom is in French, translating to "A method for making him walk without advancing."

artworks.title: Un Replatrage
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene with two figures interacting with severed heads on a cart. One figure is placing the heads on the cart, while the other is using a pickaxe. The background includes a partial wall with the word "MINISTÈRE."

artworks.title: Vous aurez beau faire, ma pauvre presse...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in a struggle. One figure is cloaked and bearded, holding a scythe over a seated figure. The seated figure appears distressed, with one hand raised. The artwork is monochromatic with bold lines and shading. Sheets of paper or banners with inscriptions are on the ground.

artworks.title: Vue d'un atelier... avant l'exposition
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an artist's studio scene before an exhibition. Two individuals are depicted, one standing and painting on a large canvas, while the other sits at the edge, holding a brush or tool. The canvas seems to contain an unfinished or abstract depiction. The background reveals a table draped with a cloth, atop of which rests a bottle and possibly other items. The composition suggests a moment of artistic creation and critique.

artworks.title: Apparition
artworks.medium: softground etching and drypoint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts two abstract figures. The first figure is seated with the upper body leaning back and the head turned to the left. The face has faint features and long dark hair. The second figure is positioned above and to the right, with similar features and possibly raising an arm. Both figures appear nude or minimally clothed. The background consists of etched lines and shades, providing a textured appearance. A signature at the bottom indicates the artist.

artworks.title: Figures of Earth
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with gray tint
artworks.description: This is a painting of abstract figures arranged in a group. The artwork depicts multiple figures intertwined and posed in various positions, some standing and others crouching, with their forms rendered in monochromatic tones. The background appears textured, possibly indicating foliage or abstract designs. The figures are slightly exaggerated and stylized, giving an impression of fluidity.

artworks.title: The Slave Market [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with charcoal, gray wash, and white chalk on gray paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of people gathered in an interior space with an arched doorway. The central focus is a bound figure standing on a platform. Around this figure, there are individuals engaged in various activities. The attire of the figures includes robes and turbans. The atmosphere is solemn or tense, with dramatic lighting casting highlights on the subjects.

artworks.title: After the Bath (La sortie du bain (Petite planche))
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white sketch of a person from behind, with their upper body and legs visible. The person is leaning forward, with their right arm across their body and holding onto a piece of fabric with their left hand. Their face is turned in profile, partly in shadow, with textured hair. The person is in front of a softly shadowed background that resembles a wall. In the foreground, there is a bed with a textured blanket or sheet, creating a soft atmosphere. The person is not wearing clothing or jewelry.

artworks.title: Africa
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene in a wilderness with animals and a figure. The image shows a nude figure reclining on the ground surrounded by a lion, elephant, and a mythological creature with a spiral tail. The detailed landscape includes trees and vegetation. The artist used elaborate line work to depict textures and musculature. The image is titled "AFRICCA" and dated 1575, with the initials S F.

artworks.title: America
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure sitting in a natural setting. The image depicts a nude figure adorned with a feathered headdress, seated beside a large dog-like creature. The figure is positioned on the left and appears to be drawing a bow, while the creature looks to the right with its mouth slightly open. The surrounding scene is heavily detailed with foliage, rocks, and tree trunks in the background, creating a forest-like environment. There are objects that resemble quivers and arrows lying on the ground near the figure. The artwork contains the text "AMERICCA" and has the date "1575" along with the initials "S F."

artworks.title: Asia
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on the ground with their legs extended, holding a mirror. The person has long hair, is draped in a cloth, and is wearing a necklace. Surrounding them are a camel, a lion, and another large animal. Trees and dense foliage are in the background.

artworks.title: Europe
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene featuring a seated, unclothed figure in a pastoral setting alongside various animals. The figure holds a branch with leaves. The scene is bordered by trees and includes intricate details such as texture on the animals' fur and fabric. The style resembles an engraving from the late Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Latona Insulted
artworks.description: This drawing features various characters and creatures in an intricate landscape. On the left, a deity or mythological figure rides a fantastical creature with feathers. In the center, figures are engaged by a riverside, with one appearing transformed into a frog-like creature. In the background, there is an architectural vista with a grand domed structure amidst a cityscape. Lush flora and natural motifs frame the interactions of the characters, conveying movement and drama through detailed lines and shading.

artworks.title: Apollo Killing Python
artworks.description: This is a painting of a battle scene. The image depicts a confrontation between a winged serpent-like creature and an archer at the center. Surrounding them are onlookers with various emotional reactions. In the sky above, three figures are seated on clouds. The background includes architectural structures and natural elements.

artworks.title: Diana and Orion
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical mythological scene in a forested area. Various figures are engaged in interactions. A central figure stands with flowing garments, with an arm extended. Surrounding figures in classical attire stand or sit, some holding spears or musical instruments. Animals, possibly hounds, are present. The background includes foliage, trees, and a building. The landscape and interactions between figures create a harmonious composition with detailed line work and shading.

artworks.title: Britomartis Jumps into the Sea
artworks.description: The image depicts a complex scene with figures, landscapes, and a ship in the background. Several figures are shown in a rugged landscape near water, with two individuals being pursued by others and surrounded by animals in the foreground. To the right, there are tumultuous waters with a ship and a struggling figure. The background includes trees, a hill with people and animals, and distant ships. The artwork is detailed with intricate linework in a Renaissance style.

artworks.title: Orion Killed by Apollo
artworks.description: This image is an engraving depicting a classical scene with numerous figures and detailed landscapes. The point of view is slightly elevated, providing a wide view. The horizon is high, showing a distant seascape with ships sailing and a town or city. The artwork uses line work and hatching for texture and depth. The color palette is brown and beige. Figures are engaged in different activities, framed by trees and rocks on the sides, leading towards a more populated area.
